integrity: Analytic generator and semigroup proof; reproducible exact-rational and finite numerical checks; literature comparisons qualified. Finite computations are not infinite proofs.
scientific_limitations: Positive body-frame diffusivities, positive rotational diffusion, stationary passive planar motion, independent Poisson complete position resets retaining orientation. No full two-time density, inference guarantee, zero rotational-rate endpoint, or uniqueness certification in the literature; equal-time fourth moments are known.
title: A sharp delayed anticorrelation threshold for position-reset anisotropic Brownian motion
